about: The graph spec's erratum (editor spec §51, spec_text_restored). The spec reached the repository by a paste. The paste cut some rules' words at an apostrophe, left a stray mark and dropped apostrophes from decision names. Each repair below was read from the owner's original in the owner's vault: Standards/Graph spec model.md and the decision notes, on 9 Nov 2026. test/graph-spec-erratum.test.js holds each repair in place.
source: Roger's vault: Standards/Graph spec model.md and the decision notes in Standards
